verification.validation: Passed 189 frontend identity and shell tests (15 files: session, LoginPage HTTPS/HTTP, shell/refusal/entry/style), frontend typecheck, generated version/manifest checks, documentation version check (73 files), repository and both prepared-package/archive generic internal-content scans, and npm view plus raw registry metadata checks for both published packages. All SDK package versions are 0.53.17; companion CLI is unchanged at 0.52.11. Reuse the unchanged immutable executor release and its six digests. changes: A failed identity.status probe (timeout, 5xx, network, business_unavailable, restarting) no longer turns on the App's own sign-in: createSession keeps enabled false, sets unavailable and re-probes with bounded backoff
Add session.unavailable and session.retry(); only a successful {enabled:true} enables the App login
Add createSession(ctx, {identity:false}) for DSM-session-only Apps to skip the identity.status probe
LoginPage never renders the account/password form unless identity is enabled; it offers Retry while the probe is unavailable
Reuse the immutable executor/v0.53.5 release and its six digests
